snippet.title: Basement To The Sky - Demo Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, it’s orange3000k! I hope you’ve all been doing well! I’ve just pushed a new update While it’s not a complete overhaul, there are several significant changes and improvements I’ve been working on:

Map Integration: No more tedious bus rides! You no longer need to take the bus to head out to the field; the maps are now seamlessly integrated.


Physics Improvements: I’ve refined the physics system. Some values were tweaked, and some parts were completely rebuilt. For example, Lift, CP, and CM are now calculated more accurately for a more realistic flight response.


Custom Grain: Instead of just selecting a pre-made grain, you can now mix and match materials to create your own! The power graph and thrust duration will vary based on your specific combination.


Economy System Rework: Say goodbye to repetitive neighbor chores! You can now earn money through your video channel from the start. Neighbor tasks have been repurposed to reward a new currency called "Tickets."


Rocket Customization: You can now adjust the length and thickness of the grain rocket body. Plus, a Paint Table has been added where you can use Tickets to buy decals and paints to style your rocket.


Rocket Computer: The Rocket Computer is finally here! You can install modules to unlock the Rocket Camera, Parachute, and Fin Control systems. Best of all, you can now code the behavior of the parachute and fins yourself!


It might not be a perfect version yet, but I truly hope you enjoy the new features!
